edges.meaning: ArcSweep relies on Observer/DEEP for evidence, provenance, replay, and receipts.
Observer uses PREMAQC-compatible state representations for relational and transition modelling.
Runa may consume PREMAQC and world state as inputs to sensory compilation.
Glyph form, phonetics, tracing, playback, and haptics share sensory infrastructure with Runa.
Hearthfire governs capability exposure, continuity, and proof around ArcSweep operations.
Lanternbridge carries bounded semantic handoffs into and across ArcSweep contexts.
Worldseed packages coherent world state without flattening the source ontology.
ArcSweep can host and navigate Terra Aeterna as a persistent world domain.
ArcSweep can host Luna while preserving its independent ontology.
ArcSweep can host Ta’veren Vaen while preserving inherited and local ontology.
